falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,150 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 low would invalidate the 78% bottom pattern match, as the prior bottom held at 4,116; this would confirm continuation lower, not a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking at 38.6 then rapidly declining; sustained elevated VIX indicates panic escalation rather than capitulation-and-recovery, breaking the bottom pattern structure

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield rises above 4.75% while S&P 500 simultaneously trades below 4,300
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with yields falling (safe-haven bid, rate-cut pricing); a yield spike with equity weakness indicates stagflationary or credit-stress dynamics incompatible with the matched bottom template

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
